chunks: Whoever performs forty Hajj will be told, ‘Intercede for whomever you wish,’ and a door from the doors of Paradise will be opened for him, through which he and those for whom he intercedes will enter.

key_terms.أَرْبَعِينَ: forty, indicating the number of pilgrimages

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for performing forty Hajj in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a great merit for one who performs forty pilgrimages, promising them the honor of shafa'ah and entry through a gate of Paradise. It emphasizes both the spiritual rank of repeated hajj and the eschatological reward awaiting such devotion.
